about: Destinations torii calls 'common' in `torii approve`. Common means usual for FiveM resources, not guaranteed safe. Only read-only endpoints scoped to one well-known owner belong here: a service that stores or serves content for anybody (paste sites, webhooks, file hosts) never does, because a backdoor can use it too. Every addition needs a reason and a source, by pull request.
